confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately grounded, while July peak-season accommodation is least certain and lira inflation could move USD values materially. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the beer anchor (about 1.9x and 1.2x) because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA table (two searches agreed), not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Turkish Mediterranean beach-resort pricing (Antalya Province peers such as Side and Kemer) for July peak season. Turkey is transcontinental and grouped under Europe for this tourism market, with USD price levels below Southern European resorts.
